title: C4OS Grill Question 036 - Browser Document Preview

questions.label: Which document preview formats should Browser support first?
questions.help: Recommended: .docx and .xlsx only, matching the original Browser plugin task.

questions.label: How should document preview be handled?
questions.help: Recommended: convert/render through a sandboxed preview pipeline with temp files and no privileged app APIs exposed to rendered content.
options: Sandboxed preview pipeline with temp files and no privileged app APIs
Render directly inside privileged app renderer

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether preview supports editing, attachments, local-file paths, trusted-root checks, or conversion failure UX.
